faq.title: What people ask before writing to us.
faq.imageAlt: Illustration of construction cranes in orange tones on a pink background

items.question: I don't know what I need, can we still talk?
items.answer: Yes. Most projects start exactly like this. Tell us the problem and we'll figure out together what's worth building.

items.question: What happens after I write?
items.answer: Someone on the team writes back. We set up a short call to understand the problem. If it makes sense, we send you scope, price and dates in writing.

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. On the first call we understand the problem and give you a number in writing before anything starts.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope, and it goes in the proposal along with the price. What never changes: you see progress every week, not a report at the end.

items.question: Do you work with small projects?
items.answer: Yes. We'd rather start with something small that goes live and add to it later than build things you won't use.

items.question: Can you work with our current systems?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with what you already have (CRMs, ERPs, spreadsheets, APIs) instead of asking you to start from zero.

items.question: I already have a tech team, can you join it?
items.answer: Yes. We can take on part of the product or add hands to your team for a defined period, with the scope in writing like any other project.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Argentina?
items.answer: Yes. We work in Spanish and English, and everything happens over video calls, on your schedule.
